title: Worker narrow range replacement
summary: Recovered the thiscall adapter at 0x5c2140. It converts destination iterators to a string offset and count with the original null-pointer rules, dispatches to erase for an empty source range and otherwise to replace, and returns this. The 24-byte string stores size and capacity at offsets 16 and 20; capacity at least 16 selects heap storage. Callers at 0x5c138d, 0x5c1551 and 0x5c1560 insert a source range at the beginning. Existing string operations remain external dependencies.
test_description: Freestanding i386 differential comparisons call the accepted original and recovered adapter with the same accepted string helpers. Inline and heap strings cover suffix erasure with null and nonnull empty sources, external same-length replacement, insertion with null destination end, and null destination endpoints. Full fixture bytes, return identity, canaries, and FS head are checked; heap pointers are normalized after confirming identity.
known_limits: The string helpers are external dependencies and must be provided by the port.
Allocation, exceptions, reversed or invalid ranges, and self-overlap are not exercised. The overlap helper uses the memmove import at 0x92d4a4, for which this task provides no trusted binding.
